sloka: तस्या विलपितम् श्रुत्वा वानर्यः सर्वतः च ताः ।परिगृह्य अंगदम् दीना दुह्ख आर्ताः परिचुक्रुशुः ॥४-२०-२३॥
transliteration: tasyā vilapitam śrutvā vānaryaḥ sarvataḥ ca tāḥ ।parigṛhya aṁgadam dīnā duhkha ārtāḥ paricukruśuḥ ॥4-20-23॥

translations.english: 'O hero, adorned with armlets, why have you departed on a long journey, deserting your dear son Angada who possesses similar virtues like you? It is not proper.
